hero.title: We recover data when the disk no longer responds
hero.desc: Recovery.uz laboratory recovers HDD, SSD, flash drives, and RAID arrays after physical and logical damage. Free diagnostics, own laboratory, and 24/7 support.

trackCard.title: Online request & status tracking
trackCard.desc: Submit a request without registration or check your current recovery status using a token.

servicesSec.title: We handle complex cases, not just simple recovery
servicesSec.desc: Content gathered from Recovery.uz pages: HDD repair, data recovery, RAID arrays, same-day service, upgrade and repair of equipment.

hdd.title: HDD & Hard Drives
hdd.label: Surface, controller, firmware, cleanroom
hdd.text: We recover data from bad blocks, PCB electronic board failures, microprogram/firmware damage, head stack assembly, and spindle motor issues.

ssd.title: SSD, USB & NAND
ssd.label: Controllers, memory chips, power circuit, logical failures
ssd.text: We work with modern SSDs, USB flash drives, and cases where regular data recovery software is completely useless.

raid.title: RAID Arrays
raid.label: RAID 0/1/5/6/10, degraded, rebuild, controllers
raid.text: We reconstruct RAID arrays after disk failures, controller configuration loss, incorrect rebuilds, and human errors.

pc.title: Computers & Laptops
pc.label: Upgrades, diagnostics, screens, spare parts
pc.text: Diagnostics, sourcing of original or certified analog components, modernization, and repair of customer devices.

about.title: Our own laboratory in Tashkent, not a broker
about.text: Recovery.uz directly states: we do not outsource your orders to subcontractors or third parties. This is critical for data privacy, as client storage often contains personal documents, photos, accounting, or sensitive code projects.

exp.title: 10 Years of Practice
exp.text: Hundreds of successfully completed tasks, a database of typical faults, and experience in complex data recovery.

pc3000.title: PC-3000 & Pro Gear
pc3000.text: We use professional hardware-software complexes (PC-3000) and licensed utilities.

privacy.title: Full Confidentiality
privacy.text: Customer data is strictly secured, never disclosed, and never transferred to third parties.

lab.title: In-house Laboratory
lab.text: We don't pass orders to middlemen. All jobs are done right inside the Recovery.uz lab.

sameday.title: Same-day diagnostics
sameday.text: Fast analysis and immediate start of work thanks to our database of typical malfunctions.

noprepay.title: No Prepayment
noprepay.text: The final cost is calculated after free diagnostics and depends entirely on the complexity.

processSec.title: Transparent steps from request to data retrieval
processSec.desc: Our primary principle: first, free diagnostics and a clear agreement on cost/time, then data recovery. Customers track progress online.

step1.title: Request
step1.text: You fill in an online request or call our laboratory directly.

step2.title: Diagnostics
step2.text: We check the media on professional hardware. Diagnostics are 100% free.

step3.title: Agreement
step3.text: We explain the issues, terms, and the exact cost before starting any recovery work.

step4.title: Recovery
step4.text: We extract your data, rebuild the directory structure, and transfer the files back to you.

casesSec.title: Common Cases
casesSec.subtitle: When to contact us immediately
items: Bad blocks and HDD surface degradation
Burnt PCB controllers or power surges
Firmware corruption and service area faults
Seized spindle motor or head assembly crash
SSD unresponsiveness, controller panic, or NAND failure
Degraded RAID, lost config, or incorrect rebuild

projectsSec.title: We develop our own engineering tools

adminpe.text: System administrator bootable USB disk based on WinPE, packed with diagnostic and data recovery tools.

admindp.text: An organized driver pack sorted by manufacturers, models, platforms, and OS versions.

contactsSec.title: Get a consultation now
contactsSec.desc: The main laboratory is in Tashkent, with partner drop-off points across Uzbekistan. Operating 24/7.
